# Prodigy Finance

> > Prodigy Finance provides international student loans for graduate programs worldwide, requiring no collateral or co-signer.

Prodigy Finance specializes in financing master's degrees and MBA programs at leading universities across the United States, United Kingdom, and globally. Their loan programs cover business schools, engineering, computer science, public health, life sciences, and arts & sciences programs at institutions like Boston University, Carnegie Mellon, Arizona State University, and many others.

## Key Topics

- International student loans
- Graduate program financing
- MBA programs and financing
- No collateral or co-signer required
- Business school loans
- Engineering and computer science programs
- Master's degree funding
- Public health and healthcare education
- Data science programs
- AACSB-accredited programs
- U.S. and UK universities
- Arts and sciences graduate programs
- Life sciences and biology programs
- Student financing solutions

- [Student Loans | Prodigy Finance](https://prodigyfinance.com): Homepage for Prodigy Finance student loans with no collateral or co-signer

- [Cardiff University - Cardiff Business School Loans](https://prodigyfinance.com/cardiff-university/cardiff-business-school): Cardiff Business School MBA and masters financing in UK
- [Audencia Business School Loans](https://prodigyfinance.com/audencia-business-school/audencia-business-school): Audencia Business School MBA and MSc program loans in Nantes, France
- [Boise State University - College of Business and Economics Loans](https://prodigyfinance.com/boise-state-university/college-of-business-and-economics): Boise State COBE MBA and business graduate program financing
